status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Niamey, Mopti and Kidal.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Niamey, Mopti og Kidal.

summary.en: Mali forces have retaken Kidal as jihadist attacks intensify across the Sahel, while a Mali drone strike killed 13 civilians claimed to target militants. In Nigeria, bandits attacked in Niger State and were repelled, killing a soldier, and a convoy of Niger Governor Bago crashed, killing four students, a driver and a young woman. Algeria has deployed troops to Niger to protect energy assets, marking its first foreign mission in over 50 years, and Niger has accused Chad of a drone strike that killed two civilians. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Mali-styrkene har gjenerobret Kidal mens jihadistangrepene intensiveres over hele Sahel, mens et malisk droneangrep drepte 13 sivile og hevdet å ha truffet militante. I Nigeria angrep banditter i Niger-stat og ble avvist, og drepte en soldat, og en konvoi med Niger-guvernør Bago styrtet, og drepte fire studenter, en sjåfør og en ung kvinne. Algerie har sendt tropper til Niger for å beskytte energianlegg, noe som markerer landets første utenlandske oppdrag på over 50 år, og Niger har anklaget Tsjad for et droneangrep som drepte to sivile. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
